memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "I will send my terror ahead of you and throw into confusion every nation you encounter. I will make all your enemies turn their backs and run. I will send the hornet ahead of you to drive the Hivites, Canaanites and Hittites out of your way. But I will not drive them out in a single year, because the land would become desolate and the wild animals too numerous for you. Little by little I will drive them out before you, until you have increased enough to take possession of the land." - Exodus 23:27-30 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
God promises to go before Israel and clear the way into the land — but then He says something surprising. He will not do it all at once. "Little by little I will drive them out before you," He says, so that the land would not become desolate and overrun before the people were ready to fill it. God's timing was deliberate and wise, working at the pace that was actually best for His people, even when they might have preferred instant victory.

What a lesson in the patience of God's ways. We often want our breakthroughs immediately, our problems solved in a single stroke, our promised land handed over all at once. But God frequently works "little by little," growing us step by step, because instant change would leave us unprepared to handle what we asked for. His slower pace is not neglect; it is wisdom. He gives us what we can steward, growing us to match the ground He entrusts to us.

If you are in a season where God seems to be moving slowly, take heart. He has not forgotten His promises to you. He is working at the pace that will truly bless you, forming your character to match your calling. God is more committed to shaping you well than to rushing you along. Trust His "little by little." The One who began a good work in you will carry it through to completion in His perfect time (Phil 1:6).

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
Am I frustrated with God's timing, wanting instant results He is giving gradually?
Can I trust that His "little by little" is shaping me for what lies ahead?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, Your timing is always wise, even when it feels slow. Help me trust Your "little by little," confident that You are shaping me well and will complete the work You began. Amen.
